id: 18_Radiological Emergencies Get Your Lab Safety Now Training Course
title: 放射性应急：实验室安全培训
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/18_Radiological Emergencies Get Your Lab Safety Now Training Course.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/18_Radiological Emergencies Get Your Lab Safety Now Training Course/src.py

points.K3: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离
points.K5: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计

shots.scene: 欣欣站在贴有电离辐射警告标志的实验室门外，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands outside a lab door marked with an ionizing radiation warning sign and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲放射性应急怎么处理。
overlay: 放射性应急：实验室安全培训

shots.scene: 同位素实验室里，一个小瓶倒在台面上，液体洒开
shots.prompt_en: In a radioisotope lab, a small vial lies tipped over on the bench with liquid spreading out. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，放射性溶液洒了。

shots.scene: 阿杰愣在原地，小研快步走来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student freezes in place while the female graduate student hurries over.
shots.narration: 阿杰一时不知道该怎么办。

shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地站在电离辐射警告标志旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an ionizing radiation warning sign with a serious face.
shots.narration: 放射性事故不常见，但同样严重。

shots.scene: 隔离、防护、去污三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a barrier, a shield and a cleaning cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 一定要知道该怎么做。

shots.scene: 洒漏处周围画出一个红色圆圈，透明塑料帘挡住
shots.prompt_en: A small spill on a bench with a red circle around it and a clear plastic curtain drawn across. No people.
shots.narration: 洒漏或泄漏，第一件事是隔离现场。

shots.section_title: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离
shots.scene: 戴蓝手套的手拉开红白警示带，立起辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a blue glove stretches red and white warning tape across the doorway, beside an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 设屏障，拉上辐射警示带，
overlay: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离

shots.section_title: 设屏障、拉警示带、人远离
shots.scene: 人群图标沿箭头远离隔离区
shots.prompt_en: Person pictograms move far away from a taped-off area along arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 让人员离得越远越好。

shots.scene: 射线源图标与人之间立起一块灰色铅屏蔽板
shots.prompt_en: A radiation source icon with a thick grey lead shielding block between it and a person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 用辐射屏蔽降低照射水平，

shots.scene: 铅砖图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A stack of grey lead bricks with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 铅是首选的屏蔽材料。

shots.section_title: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计
shots.scene: 王老师、小研、阿杰互相帮忙穿白色防护服、戴口罩
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator, the female graduate student and the young male student help each other into white protective coveralls and masks.
shots.narration: 穿戴合适的个人防护装备，
overlay: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计

shots.section_title: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计
shots.scene: 铅围裙、手套、剂量计三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a lead apron, a pair of gloves and a dosimeter badge. No people.
shots.narration: 铅围裙、手套，还有剂量计。

shots.section_title: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计
shots.scene: 剂量计图标旁有空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: A dosimeter badge icon next to a blank record book. No people.
shots.narration: 剂量计用来监测受照剂量。

shots.section_title: 防护穿戴齐全，佩戴剂量计
shots.scene: 小研穿戴齐全站在警示带前
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, fully suited with apron, gloves and dosimeter, stands at the warning tape.
shots.narration: 处理时，一定要穿戴齐全。

shots.scene: 洒漏处被吸水材料围住，箭头显示不再扩散
shots.prompt_en: The spill is ringed with absorbent material and arrows show it no longer spreading. No people.
shots.narration: 污染控制住之后，开始去污。

shots.scene: 小研小心脱下外层手套和防护用品，放进专用袋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carefully removes her outer gloves and gear and places them into a bag marked with a radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 小心脱下受污染的防护用品，

shots.scene: 戴黄手套的手用蓝布和去污剂擦台面、水槽边
shots.prompt_en: A hand in a yellow glove wipes the bench and sink edge with a blue cloth and a decontamination spray bottle with a blank label.
shots.narration: 用合适的去污剂，清洁受影响的表面。

shots.scene: 黄色辐射检测仪表盘特写，指针刻度
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a yellow radiation survey meter with a needle dial and a blank scale.
shots.narration: 用盖革计数器检测，

shots.scene: 指针回落，绿勾出现
shots.prompt_en: The meter needle drops back down and a green check mark appears. No people.
shots.narration: 确认区域已经安全。

shots.scene: 空白指南手册，封面有星条旗和原子图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank guideline handbook with a stars-and-stripes flag icon and an atom icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 以美国核管理委员会的辐射安全指南，

shots.scene: 向下的箭头和尽量低的刻度图标
shots.prompt_en: A downward arrow beside a dose gauge kept near the lowest mark. No people.
shots.narration: 和ALARA原则为准：合理可行尽量低。

shots.scene: 抄近路的箭头被打叉，按规范路线的箭头打勾
shots.prompt_en: A shortcut arrow crossed out with a red X, and a proper route arrow with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 千万不要走捷径。

shots.scene: 两人隔着黑黄警示带站立，旁边日历时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: Two people in dark protective suits stand behind black and yellow warning tape, beside a calendar and clock icon.
shots.narration: 辐射照射可能有长期影响，

shots.scene: 剂量表指针压到最低
shots.prompt_en: A dose gauge with its needle pushed down to the minimum. No people.
shots.narration: 要尽可能把它降到最低。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现隔离、屏蔽、去污图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a barrier, a lead shield and a cleaning cloth.
shots.narration: 先隔离，再屏蔽防护，然后去污。

shots.scene: 检测仪、剂量计、ALARA图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a survey meter, a dosimeter badge and a downward arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 检测确认，照射合理可行尽量低。

shots.scene: 欣欣在辐射实验室门外挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye outside a lab door with an ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 敬畏射线，不走捷径，下次见！
